# Synthetic field library input

Prepare one field named 长文检索 under the Vault-relative root `领域库结构验收/长文检索`.

Use only `corpus.json`, the three layout inputs, and `materials/`. The sources are invented document fragments prepared for a product-format test, not real papers, real PDF evidence, or completed paper analyses. Do not search, download, ingest, register a Field, or create Zotero/ZotFlow locators. Copy source materials into the isolated test field without rewriting them. The generator receives these inputs but not `EXPECTED.md`.

Generate the field-level paper list and the distinct literature, technical, and challenge views using the installed plugin's contracts. Keep every source-status limitation visible. The existing paper-analysis result contract is not under test and must not be downgraded to these small stubs.
